title: Position
description: header: a one-row strip in the right part of the results header band (osu!stable's title bar; free on lazer too). center: a stacked block between stable's score panel and grade, for skins whose grade art leaves that column empty.

title: Horizontal nudge / px
description: Shifts the block right (negative: left) from the chosen position, in 1080p pixels.

title: Vertical nudge / px
description: Shifts the block down (negative: up) from the chosen position, in 1080p pixels.

title: Backing
description: none floats the numbers on the game; scrim adds a soft dark fade behind them; panel draws the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map tints the highlight (UR, mean marker, pp gap) with a colour derived from the beatmap background; 18-lab keeps the amber accent. Judgement and early/late colours never change.

title: Show hit-error histogram
description: Timing histogram and early/late split. UR and mean stay when it is off. osu!catch has no timing, so only pp shows there.

title: Show pp and if-FC
description: pp of the score and, when combo was lost, the pp a full combo would have given and the gap. osu!stable's results screen shows no pp.

title: Hold duration / s
description: Seconds it stays up after the results screen opens. 0 keeps it up for as long as the results screen is open.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Brand tag in the header line.
